label: Massie introduces Hegseth impeachment articles, teeing up vote

clips_and_posts.text: Representative Thomas Massie introduced articles of impeachment against Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth, setting off a two-day clock for an expected House vote on charges including waging war against Iran without congressional approval and other abuses of power reut.rs/4zBXJj7

GOP Rep. Thomas Massie explains his reasoning for bringing eight articles of impeachment against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth at a press conference just minutes after formally introducing them on the House floor. Follow live updates: https://cnn.it/4fjZeKA
